notes: Configures per-user 'gh' state: this bucket's gh aliases, plus git's credential helper via 'gh auth setup-git' so HTTPS remotes stop popping the Git Credential Manager helper-selector dialog.
The credential step is skipped with a warning when gh is missing or not authenticated -- run 'gh auth login' once (it is interactive by nature), then re-run this package.

CAVEAT: 'gh auth setup-git' writes an ABSOLUTE path to the gh binary into credential.helper. A scoop-installed gh yields C:\ProgramData\scoop\apps\gh\current\bin\gh.exe, so uninstalling or moving gh breaks git authentication until you re-run 'gh auth setup-git'.
